messages.text: Incidents rose to 1,301, led by street lights & electrical hazards

card.headline: Incidents rose to 1,301, led by street lights & electrical hazards
card.answerMarkdown:
Reported incidents rose to **1,301** from 1,151 against the period before.

- **Mostly from:** Street lights & electrical hazards (109 → 154), Flooding & waterlogging (48 → 79), Drainage & sewage (46 → 74)
- **Partly offset by:** Garbage & solid waste (224 → 204), Other / unclassified (38 → 24)
- **Where:** Mylapore (street lights & electrical hazards, 19 → 21); Royapettah (street lights & electrical hazards, 10 → 14)
- **Rain:** 179 of the 1,301 were linked to rain
- **Past deadline:** Storm Water Drain (15), Roads & Building Permissions (12)

**Act first on:** Retaining wall near West St, Royapettah caved in near church at Royapettah (Govt Royapettah Hospital).
